{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = decided to come scoop him up there to deport him from NBC news quote Dugan and another

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:30.019

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.039
    | text      = This is a real mess of a situation because in a very technical legal sense, her arrest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.519
    | text      = isn't just a flimsy piece of political theater and intimidation.

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:54.679

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Dugan's actions are a bit suspicious.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:34.340

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = judicial warrant for their arrest, whereas they only had an administrative warrant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:43.379
    | text      = According to the law, she's incorrect, but if she did believe that was needed, her telling
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = them to talk to the chief judge becomes less suspicious.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}
